text: {"findings":[{"rule_id":"MF-005","evidence":[{"kind":"title_block","ref":"heat_treatment","page":1,"quote":"---"},{"kind":"note","ref":"N3","page":1,"quote":"HEAT TREATMENT :- 1) TO BE TOUGHENED UPTO 24-32 HRC. 2) RETAPPING TO BE DONE AFTER SURFACE TREATMENT AT SUPPLIER END.( IF APPLICABLE )"}],"comment":"The title block heat treatment field is '---' while note N3 specifies toughening to 24-32 HRC, and neither states when the heat treatment applies relative to machining or plating. This ambiguity can cause the supplier to apply hardening at the wrong stage, leading to distortion of finished features or inability to machine hardened stock. Update the title block heat treatment field to match N3 and add the manufacturing stage (e.g., after rough machining, before final grinding).","recommended_correction":"Update the title block heat treatment field to match N3 and add the manufacturing stage (e.g., after rough machining, before final grinding)."},{"rule_id":"WPS-004","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D4","page":1,"quote":"20±0.1"},{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D11","page":1,"quote":"23±0.1"},{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D15","page":1,"quote":"43±0.1"},{"kind":"note","ref":"N4","page":1,"quote":"NOTE : (English) # MATERIAL: C45 # FINISH: I.Z.B.P. (TRIVALENT) # MACHINING: 3.2 ( 0.8 ) # WEIGHT(Kg ): 1.01 kg"}],"comment":"Dimensions D4, D11, and D15 carry tolerance bands of 0.2 mm total (±0.1 mm), but note N4 calls for I.Z.B.P. (trivalent zinc) plating whose thickness will consume part of that tolerance. Without allowance for the plating build-up, the finished parts may fall outside the specified limits and fail to assemble. The designer should either widen these tolerances to absorb the coating thickness or add a note specifying pre-plate target dimensions.","recommended_correction":"Either widen these tolerances to absorb the coating thickness or add a note specifying pre-plate target dimensions."}]}
